title: Kinetic type to the beat
prompt: Kinetic typography to the music in the timeline (an 8-bar build into a drop). Words: "FEEL IT BUILD" during the build, getting faster toward the drop, then "DROP" as the biggest moment exactly on the drop, then "MOVE / WITH / THE / BEAT" grooving through the drop section. Words must hit on beats; don't hit every beat; end on a held final frame.

checklist.text: the biggest move lands on the drop (16.0 s, ±1 frame)
words hit on beats (≥70% of landings within ±1 frame of the 120 BPM grid)
restraint in the build: some beats are left empty
